text: A character can attempt to harvest poison from a venomous creature that is dead or has the Incapacitated condition. The effort takes 1d6 minutes, after which the character makes a DC 20 Intelligence (Nature) check using a Poisoner’s Kit. On a successful check, the character harvests enough poison for a single dose, and no additional poison can be harvested from that creature. On a failed check, the character is unable to extract any poison. If the character fails the check by 5 or more, the character is subjected to the creature’s poison.

on_success.note: One dose; nothing more can be harvested from that creature.

on_fail.note: No poison; failing by 5 or more exposes the character to the creature's poison.

effects.note: Takes 1d6 minutes with a Poisoner's Kit; the creature is dead or Incapacitated.
